title: Qwen Code with a local model
description: Qwen Code with a model on your own server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM or another OpenAI-compatible one) and nothing else: only the server's address is opened, the provider's hosts stay closed, and the loop guard keeps a small model from going round in circles.

de.title: Qwen Code mit einem lokalen Modell
de.description: Qwen Code mit einem Modell auf Ihrem eigenen Server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM oder ein anderer OpenAI-kompatibler) und sonst nichts: nur die Adresse des Servers ist offen, die Hosts des Anbieters bleiben zu, und der Schleifenschutz hält ein kleines Modell davon ab, sich im Kreis zu drehen.

llm.label: LLM server (sandbox-ai llm list), NAME or NAME:MODEL
llm.hint: sandbox-ai llm add ollama --kind ollama --url http://127.0.0.1:11434 --model MODEL

notes: Register the server once: sandbox-ai llm add NAME --kind ollama|lmstudio|llamacpp|vllm|openai-compatible --url URL --model MODEL; sandbox-ai llm check NAME --agent qwen asks it for the API Qwen Code uses.

Qwen Code gets the server in its read-only system settings (/etc/qwen-code/settings.json): OpenAI-compatible auth, the server's /v1 URL, the model and its context window, the key as a placeholder the connection proxy replaces; its own loop protection is on (stop), the loop guard's instructions are appended to its system prompt; a session ends after 120 turns (model.maxSessionTurns: the loop guard's steps where you set them), a slow model is waited for 20 minutes without a byte (60 per answer). LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM and llama.cpp all work.

The relay sets the model's parameters (sandbox-ai llm params) and the loop guard on the wire, the same for every agent. Agents need a model with tool calls and a long context (qwen3-coder, gpt-oss, ...; Ollama: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=32768 or more). On this host's loopback (http://127.0.0.1:PORT) only with Podman.
Its image first: sandbox-ai build qwen.
